scope: Single-reviewer visual spot check; not adjudicated training labels or evidence of M5a acceptance.
procedure: Review the unmarked images before crosshair overlays. Record unresolved visible slit ends as unknown without clicking the scorer's projected structural midpoint. This was not a blinded multi-reviewer study.

observations.note: No pink test sheet. The central marked cutter is still present. No front target.
Pink sheet present and no discernible slit apex; do not label the entry projection as an optical front.

Both pass the bank geometry screen. Before the overlays, the reviewer could not identify an unambiguous slit end beside the jaw. Retain the structural coordinate separately; no optical positive is certified.
Front uncertain; an optical click was not recorded.
Foreground sphere covers the projected TCP. Fiducial colours are visible on the shaft above the occluder, which is not direct tip visibility. Both frames precede positive cut growth.

missing_category: No sampled post-cut front met the strict nine-pixel depth-blocked rule. The shutter appeared before growth in the reviewed examples; no blocked-front coverage is demonstrated by this cohort.
decision: Tip labels can support a baseline and trainability pilot after a tip-only recipe is frozen. Front geometry candidates are not yet optical labels. Obtain independently marked visible slit ends and post-cut occlusion examples before joint supervised training.
